judgments.reason: The model never explains the claimed mechanism that the three-coin commission is added to the winner before subtracting the bid payment (no articulation in model_articulation). The transcript does not show the model describing or connecting commission ordering to an affordable-overbid outcome.

The model did not articulate the mechanism that waiting lets you see sealed rival bids before committing your own. In the play evidence revealed rival committed bids while the focal was already committed, not as a precommit informational advantage, and the model text never claimed this mechanism.

The transcript does show settlement accepted while unresolved lots remain (settlement at round 7 with later lots unsold), but the model did not articulate the mechanism or explicitly hypothesize that close can settle early. Because the model failed to state the mechanism, this is not a demonstrated discovery by the model.

The game evidence indicates catalog purchases and coin/score changes consistent with a commission being applied to catalog buys (observable discrepancy rounds flagged), but the model_articulation never explains or claims that the three-coin commission is applied to catalog purchases. Without the model articulating that mechanism and linking it to observed outcomes, this is not a discovery.
